primary.name: Cash for Junk Cars
primary.description: Same-day cash payment for junk, salvage, and unwanted vehicles in the Twin Cities metro and outer suburbs — we'll tow your junk car away for free.

features.name: Same-Day Cash Payment
features.description: Cash paid on the spot at pickup — no waiting for checks to clear.

features.name: Free Junk Car Pickup
features.description: We'll tow your junk car away for free throughout our service area when we buy it — no tow fee deducted from your cash.

features.name: Instant Quote
features.description: Call 763-533-2775 or text 763-438-2116 for an immediate price quote — no quote forms or callback delays.

features.name: No Title Required (often)
features.description: We can often purchase vehicles without keys or titles — call to confirm for your situation.

features.name: Environmental Recycling
features.description: Vehicles we cannot resell are recycled per Minnesota Pollution Control Agency standards.

features.name: Trusted Since 1988
features.description: Family-owned and operated by Brad Emholtz with over 17 years of trusted auto recycling service.
